findings.message: hand keypoint speed at t=2.67s is 0.63 m/s vs this episode's own median speed 0.20 m/s (within-episode z=4.6); this episode's peak jump is itself a corpus z-score of 7.0 vs other episodes' peak jumps
findings.downstream_consequence: a physically implausible jump in the labeled hand trajectory produces an action-label spike that a VLA will try to imitate; at inference this is either unreachable (policy attempts an impossible velocity) or the model learns a smoothed/averaged version that undershoots the true motion
